entities.summary: Alexander Dmitriyevich Barabanov is a Russian professional ice hockey player who is currently playing with Ak Bars Kazan in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He formerly played in the National Hockey League (NHL) for the Toronto Maple Leafs and the San Jose Sharks.
